buildCommand: pip install -r requirements-vercel.txt && python -c "import django; django.setup(); from generate_static import build_pages; build_pages()" && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://maps.googleapis.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https://res.cloudinary.com https://maps.googleapis.com; connect-src 'self' https://*.up.railway.app https://*.vercel.app https://maps.googleapis.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self';
